blocks.label: Current Beat
blocks.body: The brush goes still. Whatever you did, it is done. The horses breathe hard. The road smells like wet thorn, churned mud, and adrenaline fading too slowly. Among what was dropped, you see gear that does not look like bandit scrap: stamped buckles, route...

blocks.label: Public Objective
blocks.body: Decide what to do with what just happened and get the package moving again.

affordances: Ask one practical question before acting.
